fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic (ANT) raised $8.13 billion at November 18 IPO price of $83, setting an all-time IPO record and exceeding SpaceX (+4.35%, $75B) and Saudi Aramco ($25.6B).
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX priced at $135 in June and closed at $160.95 (+19%) on first trading day with current market cap of KRW 2.1 trillion; Visa posted 2,854% return since 2008 IPO, and Meta recorded 1,572% return after initial 47% decline from 2012 IPO.
